ios.desc:
pushr is your new favorite workout companion. use it to intelligently count your push-up repetitions using facial tracking and keep track of your progress. all in a beautiful interface designed to keep you motivated.

COUNT PUSH-UPS
use pushr to automatically count your push-ups while looking at your iPhone. log your push-up workouts with sets, reps, and rest times – and store stats such as average push-up duration, rest time, and weather conditions.

KEEP A STREAK
log at least one workout each day and keep your streak going as strong as you. you can also enable a daily notification so you don't miss a day.

SHARE YOUR PROGRESS
select any workout and share your glory on Instagram stories with a single tap, sync your workouts automatically with the Health and Fitness apps. or, do your best to contribute to our live global push-ups counter.

pushr is constantly being updated with new features and improvements. if you have any feedback or suggestions, please reach out at pushr@joogps.com.

keep pushin'
